newsitem.title: LATVIA: BOURSE SEES CONTINUOUS TRADE, TO EXTEND FIXING.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE SEES CONTINUOUS TRADE, TO EXTEND FIXING.

text.p: The Riga stock exchange said on Friday that it will introduce continuous trading in the five to seven most liquid stocks by November and prolong the morning price fix by the late summer.
"The bourse plans to introduce trading with changing prices (during the session) for some of the most liquid stocks," Uldis Cerps, the bourse president, told a news conference.
"Five, six, seven (stocks), it depends on the wishes of the market participants," Cerps added.
The bourse also plans to extend morning price fixings by around two hours to three and allow both selling and buying instead of just one side, depending on whether bids or offers dominated.
